data.one_liner: Provides native-looking titlebar buttons for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
data.what_it_does: A Flutter package that supplies customizable close, minimize, and maximize buttons styled after various native operating system themes (such as Windows, Linux, and macOS). It supports auto-detection of the theme or manual selection via a property.
use_when: You are building a desktop application with custom window decorations.
You need native-looking window control buttons for Windows, Linux, and macOS.
avoid_when: You are building strictly for mobile platforms (Android, iOS) where desktop titlebar buttons are irrelevant.
You prefer using standard default platform window frames without custom titlebars.
strengths: Provides native-looking buttons for multiple platforms (Windows, Linux, macOS).
Easy to implement with explicit decorated button widgets like DecoratedMinimizeButton.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside basic README examples.
Relies on system gsettings/dbus configuration dependencies which might behave differently across specific Linux desktop environments.
